mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM training_sessions WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'completed' AND DATE(ended_at) = CURDATE()
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_notices (user_id, notice_type, content, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{noticeType}, #{content}, #{createdAt})
mapper.select: SELECT notice_id AS id, content FROM user_notices WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND read_at IS NULL ORDER BY notice_id DESC
